To connect YouTube to ChatGPT so it can read video transcripts, add TranscriptAPI’s hosted MCP server as a plugin. In ChatGPT on the web, open **Plugins**, click the plus button, choose **Add custom MCP server**, enter `https://transcriptapi.com/mcp` and choose OAuth, using a Client ID and Client Secret from your [TranscriptAPI dashboard](https://transcriptapi.com/dashboard/mcp-integration). Create and install the plugin, then type **@** in a new chat to select it.

TranscriptAPI’s MCP connector lets ChatGPT call TranscriptAPI’s hosted YouTube transcript API directly from a conversation, using the [Model Context Protocol](https://transcriptapi.com/docs/mcp/) (MCP) — the same open standard TranscriptAPI also supports for Claude and OpenAI Agent Builder. Once connected, ChatGPT can fetch a video’s transcript, search YouTube, browse a channel’s videos, or page through a playlist, without you copying captions in by hand. # TranscriptAPI
Full YouTube data toolkit via [TranscriptAPI.com](https://transcriptapi.com). Transcripts, search, channels, playlists — one API key.

Every request needs two headers:
- **Authorization:** `Bearer $TRANSCRIPT_API_KEY`
- **User-Agent:** your agent's name and version if known (e.g. `HermesAgent/0.11.0`, `ClaudeCode/1.0`). Version is optional — agent name alone is fine. Do not omit this header or send a bare default — Cloudflare will return a 403 (error code 1010) and block the request.
## API Reference
Full OpenAPI spec: [transcriptapi.com/openapi.json](https://transcriptapi.com/openapi.json) — consult this for the latest parameters and schemas.
## Auth
All requests: `-H "Authorization: Bearer $TRANSCRIPT_API_KEY"`
## Endpoints
Channel endpoints accept `channel` — an `@handle`, channel URL, or `UC...` ID. No need to resolve first. Playlist endpoints accept `playlist` — a playlist URL or ID.
### GET /api/v2/youtube/transcript — 1 credit
```
GET https://transcriptapi.com/api/v2/youtube/transcript?video_url=VIDEO_URL&format=text&include_timestamp=true&send_metadata=true
Authorization: Bearer $TRANSCRIPT_API_KEY
User-Agent: YourAgent/1.0
```
| Param | Required | Default |

results.title: YouTube Transcript API: The Complete Developer Guide
results.snippet:
A YouTube transcript API is a service that extracts the text content from YouTube videos and returns it as structured data. You send a video URL. You get back the transcript as JSON or plain text. That's the short version.

At a high level, a transcript API does four things:
1. Accepts a video URL or ID from you
2. Fetches the caption data from YouTube's servers
3. Parses the raw format into clean, structured output
4. Returns it to you as developer-friendly JSON
That middle step is where all the complexity lives. YouTube wasn't built to be a text API. The transcript data is buried in internal endpoints, wrapped in XML, and protected by anti-scraping measures. A good transcript API hides all that mess.

YouTube keeps captions in a format called TimedText XML. This data lives on a separate server from the video stream itself. It's not embedded in the video file. It's a separate resource that the YouTube player fetches when you click the CC button.

results.title: How to give AI agents access to YouTube data via MCP
results.snippet:
The Model Context Protocol (MCP) fixes this. It's a standardized way for AI agents to connect to external tools and data sources. TranscriptAPI's native MCP server bridges the gap between your AI agent and YouTube's entire transcript library.

MCP solves this by giving agents real-time access to transcripts, YouTube search, and channel data through a protocol they already understand.

It exposes 12 tools through the MCP protocol (the full list is in the [MCP docs](https://transcriptapi.com/docs/mcp/)). The main ones include:
1. **Get transcript** -- extract the full transcript from any YouTube video
2. **Search YouTube** -- find videos or channels by keyword
3. **List channel videos** -- get all videos from a specific channel (paginated)
4. **Search within a channel** -- find specific content from a creator
5. **Get channel info** (`get_channel_info`) -- get a channel's profile: title, @handle, subscriber and video counts, description, and the tabs it has. Accepts an @handle, channel URL, or channel ID (1 credit)
6. **Get latest uploads** -- check a channel's newest videos (free)
7. **List playlist videos** -- get all videos in a playlist (paginated)
Each tool maps to a TranscriptA
